traditions.label: Slavonic / Glagolitic Roman books
traditions.scope: Historical Church Slavonic Roman celebrant-book tradition, distinct from Byzantine Slavonic and from independent modern translations.
traditions.coverage_note: 1631 mandate directly witnessed; 1741/1893 linguistic redactions remain provisional pending prayer/rubric collation. 1483 is an incomplete original-copy witness; 1896/1905 are uncollated printing leads.

sources.title: Missale Romanum Slavonico idiomate (Rome: Typographia Polyglotta S. Congregationis de Propaganda Fide, 1893)
sources.inspection: Whole 792-page PDF acquired/hash-verified; images of title PDF 7, approval PDF 8, bilingual Urban VIII act PDF 12–13 inspected. Whole source PDF pages 7–13 retained losslessly as derivative.
sources.limitations: This is an original celebrant-book witness in Church Slavonic/Glagolitic, not a modern lay translation. Approval says it faithfully represents the Roman Missal; neither approval nor title proves a distinct Latin source recension. No Glagolitic body transcription or complete comparison.

sources.title: Lucas Jelić, Fontes historici liturgiae Glagolito-Romanae a XIII ad XIX saeculum (Veglae, 1906)
sources.inspection: Whole 544-page PDF acquired; images of XVII pp 26–27 (PDF 164–165), XIX p 91 (PDF 412) inspected. XVIII pp 3 and 30, XIX pp 102–103 inspected in extracted text only.
sources.limitations: XVII no. 87 abbreviates original act as shown by 1893 reproduction. XIX no. 108 gives approval date 1878, conflicting with original 1893 approval leaf dated 1893. The original controls; do not inherit erroneous year. XIX no. 115 calls 1905 second edition, while Lokmer calls it third after 1896; original printing sequence still needs checking.

sources.title: Juraj Lokmer, Tiskane glagoljske liturgijske knjige u knjižnici senjskoga biskupijskog arhiva, Senjski zbornik 35 (2008), 161–212
sources.inspection: Whole 52-page PDF acquired/hash-verified. Images of printed 164 (1631 title), 181 (1741 redaction/1789 supplement), 185 (1741 title) and 193 (1893/1896/1905) inspected; pp. 170, 182–187, 194 located/read in extracted text.
sources.limitations: Modern protected scholarship and page renders are not republished. Author physically inspected named Senj copies; descriptions are attributed copy-level research, not an independent direct full-book collation. Identical 1741 title on partial Dead-Mass extracts makes title alone insufficient.

sources.title: NSK RI-4-62a, Misal po zakonu rimskoga dvora, 22 February 1483
sources.inspection: Complete HTML and 432-canvas manifest acquired; holding-library colophon transcription and copy-defect metadata read. All 432 offered images acquired with HTTP 200, totaling 420,134,949 original JPEG bytes, and retained in six lossless PDF parts. Every embedded image independently extracted and hash-matched. Visual inspection remains bounded to canvases 427–428; canvas 428 has the colophon at lower right.
sources.limitations: Complete offered image-sequence acquisition is not physical-copy completeness. The catalogue declares 211 of 220 leaves, with missing leaves and misbinding. The date follows the catalogue’s colophon transcription; no independently verified Glagolitic transcription or full-book collation is supplied.

sources.title: Ana Mihaljević, Glagoljica, Staroslavenski institut
sources.inspection: Whole HTML acquired; historical-book section read, including return to Croatian Church Slavonic in 1893 and Vajs 1905 edition.
sources.limitations: Institutional modern scholarly overview not republished. Supports linguistic-recension characterization, not specific changed prayers or an independent normative lineage.

stages.label: Urban VIII revision mandate for Slavonic Roman missal
stages.scope: Missal-level normative revision and replacement prescription, not enumerated prayer changes.
stages.witness_label: Urban VIII revision mandate for Slavonic Roman missal
stages.summary: Ecclesia catholica mandates a missal corrected against the Pius V and Clement VIII Roman emendations, from multiple Dalmatian Slavonic missals. It prohibits use of older printed/manuscript Slavonic books and prescribes new book or Latin after eight months from Roman publication.

evidence.claim: Dated 29 April 1631; posting certificate 29 November 1631. Text expressly identifies correction/conformity and replacement.
1631 title and Levaković preparation identify historical celebrant witness.

stages.limitations: Original 1631 body not acquired; no actual-use abolition or exact prayer/rubric delta claimed. Need precise target source/prayer collation; no immediate 1483 parent.
stages.reception: Prescription, printing and regional reception are separate. No universal implementation date asserted.

stages.label: Karaman/Sović East Slavonic redaction candidate
stages.scope: Historical source-language redaction; component changes uncollated.
stages.summary: Copy-based scholarship reports complete East Slavonic linguistic recension and an initial pro aliquibus locis appendix; later 1789 supplement is separately bound.

evidence.claim: Redaction description and original title photo checked.

stages.limitations: Language-redaction characterization does not by itself establish changed ritual/prayer content; no accepted independent Latin source revision or exact before/after transition. Whole original 1741 and supplements required.
stages.reception: Prescription, printing and regional reception are separate. No universal implementation date asserted.

stages.label: Parčić Croatian Church Slavonic restoration witness
stages.scope: Approved historical native-language expression; Latin source-recension identity unresolved.
stages.witness_label: Parčić Croatian Church Slavonic restoration witness
stages.summary: Title names Pius V, Clement VIII, Urban VIII and Leo XIII. Approval 25 January 1893 attests faithful Roman Missal version; institutional scholarship describes return to Croatian Church Slavonic.

evidence.claim: Original title 1893 and printing permission 25 January 1893 directly visible.

stages.limitations: No exact body wording has been collated against 1741 or Latin 1884; publication permission is not evidence of an independent Latin recension. 1896/1905 not automatically distinct.
stages.reception: Prescription, printing and regional reception are separate. No universal implementation date asserted.

gaps.missing: Complete printed/multiple manuscript comparison; 1631, 1706, 1741, 1789, 1896, 1905 full originals; precise substantive deltas; local reception.
gaps.next_source: NSK RI-4-62a and second 1483 copy; Vienna 25B124 Nr. 5765 (1631); Senj 16.409/15.974 (1631), 15.724/15.795 (1741 with 1789), 15.721 and 15.723 partial extracts; original 1896/1905 titles and approvals.
gaps.consequence: A real historical native Roman celebrant-book trajectory is established, but its full version genealogy and source-defined complete texts remain open.
